title: IncrementalClassificationECOC Fit
text: Fit incremental ECOC classification model, 4 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Prior data type} sets Data type of prior term; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental classification ECOC model, {Add input port for observation weights} adds second input port for observation, {Add input port for resetting trained learner} adds input port for resetting trained incremental, {Predictor data observation dimension} sets the observation dimension of predictor data, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Binary learner beta data type} sets the data type of linear coefficient estimates output, {Binary learner beta data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of beta for range checking, {Binary learner beta data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of beta for range checking, {Binary learner bias data type} sets the data type of intercept estimates output, {Binary learner bias data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of bias for range checking, {Binary learner bias data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of bias for range checking, {Binary learner internal states data type} sets the data type of binary learner internal states output, {Binary learner internal states data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of binary learner internal states for range checking, {Binary learner internal states data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of binary learner internal states for range checking, {Prior data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of prior term for range checking, {Prior data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of prior term for range checking, {Binary learner mu data type} sets the data type of binary learner mu output, {Binary learner mu data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of binary learner mu for range checking, {Binary learner mu data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of binary learner mu for range checking, {Binary learner sigma data type} sets the data type of binary learner sigma output, {Binary learner sigma data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of binary learner sigma for range checking and {Binary learner sigma data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of binary learner sigma for range checking. Values come from the instance.
